description: This script reformats PEM files by parsing and adding ASN.1 structure comments using OpenSSL, primarily for testing or formatting purposes.

classes.name: PemBlock
classes.description: Represents a PEM block with name, data, and comment attributes.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Formats and annotates PEM data with ASN.1 structure comments.

methods.name: GenerateCommentForBlock
methods.description: Generates ASN.1 structure description for a PEM block using OpenSSL.

methods.name: GetUserComment
methods.description: Extracts user comments from PEM block comments, removing script-generated lines.

methods.name: MakePemBlockString
methods.description: Creates a PEM formatted string from block name and data.

methods.name: GetPemFilePaths
methods.description: Retrieves all PEM file paths in the script's directory.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: WrapTextToLineWidth
methods.description: Wraps text to a specified line width.

methods.name: EncodeDataForPem
methods.description: Base64 encodes data and wraps it for PEM formatting.

methods.name: StripAllWhitespace
methods.description: Removes all whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: IsEntirelyWhiteSpace
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only whitespace.

methods.name: DecodePemBlockData
methods.description: Decodes base64 PEM block data after stripping whitespace.

methods.name: GetPemBlocks
methods.description: Extracts PEM blocks from data using regex matching.

methods.name: WriteStringToFile
methods.description: Writes string data to a specified file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes all PEM files in the directory.
